# SoldEasier

> SoldEasier (soldeasier.com) buys houses directly from their owners across Chicagoland, covering DuPage, Cook, Will, Kane, Lake, and McHenry counties in Illinois, and prepares and manages every closing itself. Sellers pay no fees or commissions, sell 100% as-is, and choose their own closing date. Closings can happen in as little as two weeks because purchases involve no financing.

Founded by Vincent Incopero (a closings specialist with a title-company background and deep experience in complicated transactions) and Brady Schwartz (acquisitions and technology). Sellers talk directly to the founders, and there is no call center.

Key facts:
- Phone: (847) 212-2142 · Office: 5646 St Charles Road, Suite D, Berkeley, IL 60163
- Immediate written offers within 24-48 hours of contact, with the math shown
- Specializes in complicated sales most buyers avoid: foreclosure and pre-foreclosure, probate and inherited homes, divorce sales, tenant-occupied rentals, homes needing major repairs, short sales, deed-in-lieu, liens and building-code violations, land trusts
- The closing work of the transaction comes fully handled, and sellers may have anyone they trust review the paperwork
